attributes.name: adapt
attributes.digest: Adapt output dims to input
attributes.description: Adapt output dims to input (default = 1). When enabled the output dimensions will match the leftmost input dimensions.

attributes.name: amt
attributes.digest: Effect amount
attributes.description: The amount of noise on the output texture (default = 0.5)

attributes.name: bypass
attributes.digest: Bypass effect processing
attributes.description: Bypass effect processing flag (default = 0). When enabled the input is passed through to the output without processing.

attributes.name: color_tint
attributes.digest: Color tint amount
attributes.description: Color tint amount (default = 0.6). Useto adjust the blend between the red, green, and blue noise components, controlling the color variation of the grain. It determines how much the green and blue noise channels deviate from the red noise channel, adding more color diversity to the grain effect.
